Since November 2022 · My Angel

Happy Birthday,
Vasu

I can't be there to celebrate with you in person this year, so this is me sending it across the distance instead — every bit of it true.

↓ scroll ↓
My favourite human

Just you, being you

November 2022

The day my angel showed up

We met on my birthday, of all days — and from that moment you became my protection, my person, my angel. I don't think you've ever stopped showing up for me since.

Just you

So much give, so little ask

You're always there for everyone — for your husband building his business, for your community, for me. The way you open your heart to people, the way you give without keeping score, is who you actually are.

A day I'll never forget

The day you told me you were getting home

You wrapped up in that blanket and told me the news — one of the most beautiful moments we've shared. I felt so lucky to be there for it.

Pink dress, red dress

The first time we celebrated your birthday

Sashimi, sake, and the two of us dressed up properly. It was the first time I got to celebrate you in person, and it felt as special as it should have.

On the river

Headphones on, drifting down the Thames

Watching a film together on a boat on the Thames, headsets on, just the two of us in our own little world in the middle of the city.

All of us

Notting Hill, just the two of us

We'd already moved to Greenwich together as neighbours, living right next to each other — and from there we just kept exploring London side by side. That night in Notting Hill, in front of that blue door, we said it out loud: one day we'll move there too. You're so rare, Vasu — genuinely pure-hearted in a way I don't see in many people. I can't wait for the day we're packing boxes again, moving across London together, still side by side.

Greenwich, flags and all

That evening by the pub

Bunting overhead, a proper London evening, just wandering and talking the way we always do.

Hyde Park, mid-sushi-coma

You, on my knees, in the park

One of the most beautiful days — though all that sushi beforehand meant the walk through Hyde Park did absolutely nothing to help us. Worth it anyway.

Aprons, obviously

The most random, most us, photo

Of course our funniest photo together is in a bathroom, mid-apron, mid-laugh. Completely ridiculous, completely us.

Happy Birthday, my angel 💛

Since that November day in 2022, you've been my protection and my person. The way you give — to your husband, to your community, to me, to everyone lucky enough to know you — is who you are at your core.

You constantly learn, you want to be better, you want to help, you want to evolve. And you will get there with everything cut away that doesn't serve it. I can't wait to watch the life you're building for yourself. I'm sure you'll have everything your heart desires.

I'm sorry I can't be there to celebrate with you tomorrow — but know that wherever you are, I'm celebrating you.

With all my love, always — Mariana
